about: NOTE: All multiplayer servers for NBA 2K25 will be shutdown as of 12/31/2026. After that time, all game functions requiring online servers will no longer function.
This edition includes a digital copy of NBA 2K25 for PlayStation®5 and PlayStation®4.

Compete your way as you define your legacy in MyCAREER and MyTEAM, and experience MyNBA and The W on PS5® or MyLEAGUE on PS4®. Express your personality with an array of customization options and explore an all-new City (for PS5®) or urban metropolis in the Neighborhood (for PS4®).

Experience your favorite NBA players’ signature moves and fine-tune your skills to deliver career-defining plays in dramatic fashion. Bring your game to life with ProPLAY™ on PS5®, immersive technology that directly translates NBA footage into engaging gameplay. Get up close and personal with your favorite NBA superstars and immerse yourself in the most authentic NBA experience to date.

Honor NBA legends in MyCAREER as you eclipse their milestone achievements and usher in the greatest dynasty the sport has ever seen. The City on PS5® is the ultimate proving ground; hit the park for some competitive streetball fun and compete at various new venues. Or dominate in the new Neighborhood on PS4® as you complete quests, earn rewards and eclipse your Rivals in new and returning game modes.

Competition thrives in MyTEAM. Challenge rival lineups with your all-time MyTEAM roster, and clash with other elite players in the weekly King of the Court. Go head-to-head and showcase why you deserve to be crowned the best of the best in this exclusive event.
Play Now, MyNBA, The W, and MyLEAGUE are available offline. All other game modes and features require Internet connection and may require online account registration (varies 13+).
